title: Rice with Mussels
id: MAR-0094
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 55
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g rice
- 800 g mussels
- 400 g tomato pulp
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 1 garlic clove
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Clean the mussels, place them in a saucepan, cover and let them open over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, stirring them.
2. Shell them and strain the liquid that has formed in the container.
3. Peel the garlic and let it wilt in a pan with the oil; after 3 minutes remove it, pour in the tomato pulp, moisten it with the mussel liquid and cook for 30 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
4. Meanwhile, cook the rice in boiling salted water, drain it, add it to the tomato sauce, add the mussels, mix and serve.
